prompt:
Create a clean transparent-background six-view sprite atlas of the exact physical source objects in the supplied labeled reference contact sheet. Preserve each source identity, object count, palette, pixel-art ink/texture, proportions and distinctive construction details. These are inferred orthographic illustrations, not recovered hidden pixels. Strict axis-aligned principal cameras: columns exactly FRONT, TOP (camera straight down Z), RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM (camera straight up Z), REAR; no isometric or 3/4 views, no perspective, no foreshortening except true end-on silhouettes. Use one complete object per row, in the exact listed row order. The whole connected object must fit each cell with transparent margins; no clipping, neighboring cells, stray labels, shadows, guides or scenery. Six columns by four rows, square atlas, evenly sized cells and gutters. Keep each object pose/orientation fixed across views; opposite views must reverse landmark ordering as physical cameras require. Keep a readable pixel-art look matching the references.
Row order: (1) iron-stations-station-tiled-masonry-outer-corner, (2) iron-stations-station-tiled-masonry-inner-corner, (3) iron-stations-station-tiled-masonry-wall-northwest, (4) iron-stations-station-tiled-masonry-wall-northeast.
Material is gray cut station stone, thick black/dark border grout and the source cyan tile stripe only; absolutely no gold/palace arches, red banners, blue plinths, signage or extra ornament. The L-corner objects must retain their source L plan with two perpendicular joined arms; top/bottom show the same L footprint. Their four elevations are full broad rectangular masonry walls of common height; show the corresponding joined/corner face in each cardinal direction without a 3D corner perspective. The northwest long wall runs world X: FRONT/REAR broad, RIGHT/LEFT narrow ends, TOP/BOTTOM long horizontal strips. The northeast long wall runs world Y: FRONT/REAR narrow ends, RIGHT/LEFT broad, TOP/BOTTOM long vertical strips. Preserve cyan trim at its source-supported position and consistent shared height. For front/rear and right/left, use source layout to determine the correct broad/end face, not a diagonal corner view.
